environment.description: Same task worker binary deployed in EKS cluster (eks-prod-usw2-047). Pod runs in namespace 'batch-workers' with NetworkPolicy allowing ingress only from pods labeled 'app=task-orchestrator' in namespace 'control-plane'. External access routes through an internal NLB (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:111222333444:loadbalancer/net/internal-batch-nlb/a1b2c3d4e5f6) configured with target group health checks only. NLB listener has no public-facing DNS; it is registered in AWS Cloud Map under 'batch-worker.internal.prod.local'. The NLB's associated security group (sg-0xf9e8d7c6) restricts inbound to CIDR 10.40.0.0/16 (control-plane subnet) and 10.41.0.0/16 (monitoring subnet). VPC has no internet gateway attached to the private subnets where worker pods schedule. Additionally, the EKS node group instances run in private subnets with route tables pointing only to NAT gateway for egress and VPC endpoints for AWS services. Pod security context sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops ALL capabilities except NET_BIND_SERVICE.
